propositions: ADR 0035 §(d) backend interface specification is currently unspecified, blocking decomposition and plan-review of Phase 2 implementation stories S2–S5.

The reconciler backend interface must pin four design decisions: rebar's local ticket as canonical model, core owns diff/apply with adapters read-only, role Protocols behind Backend facade, and RemoteRef type for identity tuples.

The ADR revision must document five role Protocols (TicketTransport, OutboundMapper, InboundMapper, FieldSanitizer, IdentityConvention) plus capability Protocols (SupportsLinks, SupportsComments, SupportsIncremental).
Three architectural leaks must be fixed: ADF-sizing removal from differ, lossy-status/parent rules moved to Jira adapter, and duplicated value-maps/link-constants consolidated.
Backend registry keyed on config.reconciler.backend with proof-of-seam contract suite and test-only FakeBackend, deferring real GitHub adapter to epic be74.
